title: Mystery gift
body:
The Mystery gift is a gift that was obtainable during the Oaklands x My Island collab. The player was awarded 3 gifts for every 1000 studs they sold to the Bacon Hair NPC. The gift would give you one of 7 random items

Items obtainable from the gift:

  • Grudge (Stud)
  • Skeleton Stud Dragon Head
  • Skeleton Stud Dragon Body
  • Skeleton Stud Dragon Tail
  • My Island Trophy
  • Emberbane (Stud)
  • Stud Helicopter
